verify_points.desc: Selecting a v2 composition track exposes stable editable inspector fields with AI-addressable selectors.
Typing into a composition field updates preview immediately without rerendering away the active input.
Blur/change saves the typed value through the same IPC path, preserving numeric values as numbers.
A draft export after save uses the saved composition JSON in its source sidecar.

items.title: Select v2 track and expose editor fields

evidence.result: final-title row and inspector fields were visible; capture wrote a 3016x1936 PNG.

items.title: Stable field typing and preview update

ai_tools.command: target/debug/nf devtools --project v2-showcase --episode showreel-24s --query 'nf-inspector::shadow [data-field-path="params.title"]' --fill 'NEXTFRAME LIVE EDIT'
ai_tools.expected: same input/change path updates preview then saves

ai_tools.command: target/debug/nf composition show --project v2-showcase --composition showreel-24s --track final-title --field params.title
ai_tools.expected: selected value equals NEXTFRAME LIVE EDIT

ai_tools.command: target/debug/nf composition show --project v2-showcase --composition showreel-24s --track final-title --field params.x | jq '.selected, (.selected|type)'
ai_tools.expected: numeric params fields remain JSON numbers after devtools fill/save

commands: target/debug/nf devtools --project v2-showcase --episode showreel-24s --query 'nf-inspector::shadow [data-field-path="params.title"]' --fill 'NEXTFRAME LIVE EDIT' --get value
target/debug/nf composition show --project v2-showcase --composition showreel-24s --track final-title --field params.x | jq '.selected, (.selected|type)'
evidence.result: preview text contained NEXTFRAME LIVE EDIT, save state was saved, and params.x persisted as 61 / number.

ai_tools.expected: source sidecar title equals saved edit

evidence.result: draft export succeeded with bytes=3804694, frames=720, duration_ms=24000; sidecar title was NEXTFRAME LIVE EDIT and x remained number.
